MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

§ 1. DEFINITIONS
"Business Day" means any day other than Saturday, Sunday, or a public holiday in the State of New York.
"Effective Date" means January 1, 2024.
"Confidential Information" refers to any proprietary technical or business data disclosed by either party.

§ 2. PAYMENT TERMS
Payment shall be due within thirty (30) days following receipt of an undisputed invoice.
Licensee shall pay an annual subscription fee of $120,000 in equal quarterly installments.

§ 3. TERM AND TERMINATION
This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and continue until December 31, 2025.
Either party may terminate this Agreement upon fifteen (15) Business Days prior written notice in the event of material breach.
Upon termination, Licensee shall immediately return all Confidential Information.
